name: American Sheet Metal
old_description: Reliable heating keeps your family warm through Montana’s coldest months. Our team specializes in installations, repairs, and maintenance to ensure your system runs efficiently all winter long.
about:
American Sheet Metal operates from Helena, Montana, where it has served the local community for over 25 years. The company is family-owned, though the founding year and founders' names are not publicly disclosed. It began as a local HVAC and sheet metal service provider, emphasizing neighborly care for homes and businesses in the region.

The company provides a range of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services, including heating system installation and repair, air conditioning installation and repair, ductless HVAC systems, indoor air quality solutions such as air filtration and humidity control, and duct cleaning. It also operates an online shop offering HVAC products and custom sheet metal solutions, suggesting some fabrication capability for ductwork and related components. Specific facility size, headcount, or production volumes are not disclosed.

American Sheet Metal primarily serves residential and light commercial customers in the Helena area. Its services address home comfort needs, including heating, cooling, and air quality, with no specific industrial sectors or named commercial clients mentioned in the available information.

The company distinguishes itself through its family-owned structure, local presence, and a stated commitment to quality products and customer-first service. It emphasizes treating every home as its own and living in the community it serves, positioning itself as a trusted neighbor rather than a distant contractor.
